The hold was "the currency is not established", and it was the right hold: this board carries its own futures quote, so cash minus basis reconciles internally whatever the money, and CAD per bushel corn lands inside the [2, 12] band. Nothing in the schema could say which currency it was, so nothing did.

That is now expressible. lib/currency.mjs resolves a board's currency from the payload where the feed states one, from this manifest where it does not, and from the province as a last resort; merge_bids.mjs withholds any row whose currency it cannot establish, and every published row carries `currency`, `country` and `currencyVia`. This source resolves CAD via `declared`, and a consumer that wants only measured currencies can filter it out on that field.

WHAT IS STILL NOT MEASURED, AND IT IS THE SAME THING THE OLD NOTE SAID: nobody has read one row of this board against a known quote. `declared` is evidence, not a fact, and it is labelled as evidence all the way to the consumer. The board itself has never been read by this repository -- it was found by the sweep and skeletoned, never polled.

cashRounding is STILL NOT SET and still must not be guessed. Expect the first live poll to refuse if this board floors or rounds to the cent. THAT REFUSAL IS THE MEASUREMENT and is the reason to enable this now rather than later: a source held disabled forever produces no evidence about itself.
